name: usage-hud
title: Usage HUD
description: See Claude, Codex, and Gemini usage limits, reset times, and confidence labels recorded by the Usage HUD menu-bar app.
author: thaliabloom

commands.name: show-usage-limits
commands.title: Show Usage Limits
commands.subtitle: Usage HUD
commands.description: Show the current session and weekly limits, reset times, and data freshness for each AI coding provider tracked by Usage HUD.

preferences.name: stateDirectory
preferences.title: State Folder
preferences.description: Folder that holds Usage HUD snapshots. Leave empty to use ~/.codex-usage-hud.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
